scope: Durable profile-scoped settings and connected UI for independently selecting a provider/model for each of the seven AI task types. No production AI consumer is claimed.

candidate.status: Source and evidence/planning checkpoint fast-forward integrated into synchronized local/GitHub main.

acceptance.all_seven_task_types_are_user_configurab: PASS - job parsing, job scoring, requirement extraction, resume tailoring, cover letters, free-form answers and company summarization are editable independently in AI Settings.
acceptance.disabled_defaults_and_explicit_local_pro: PASS - each profile defaults to disabled for all tasks; the UI only offers disabled or the registered loopback-only Ollama provider; saving settings does not call a model.
acceptance.durable_profile_scoped_read_write: PASS - API and SQLite/PostgreSQL persist and reload task selections; a second profile remains disabled and does not receive another profile selection.
acceptance.input_safety: PASS - unknown tasks/providers, secret-shaped model identifiers, extra credential fields and malformed request bodies fail closed; API responses do not echo rejected values and no credential field exists in storage.
acceptance.connected_browser_behavior: PASS - real Chromium UI saves two different Ollama model selections for separate tasks, reloads them, switches profiles without leakage, and remains usable at 390px.
acceptance.production_task_consumer_and_live_infere: PARTIAL/NOT_RUN - no production task consumer reads the persisted selections and no model inference was performed; issue #110 remains OPEN/PARTIAL.

local_validation.environment: Windows isolated Git worktree; Python 3.12.10; Vite 8.3.1; local SQLite migration plus disposable PostgreSQL 17 container bound only to loopback; no model call made.

commands.skip_note: One optional PostgreSQL integration test skipped because MJOBS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL is unset; a separate disposable PostgreSQL 17 validation passed.

expected_red_and_recovered_failures: API acceptance tests first failed with 404 because the settings route did not exist; after implementation, an error-response test found FastAPI echoed an extra api_key value. A route-scoped sanitized validation response fixed the leak and all four API tests passed.
Initial isolated fixture setup tried to seed profile rows before binding its operation mode; test setup was corrected to bind the synthetic database first.
Browser RED check initially skipped until the local build was available, then failed because AI Settings navigation was absent; after UI implementation all 38 browser tests passed.
Initial frontend build from the fresh worktree could not find tsc; used the already installed repository-locked frontend dependencies through an ignored local junction and built successfully.

The first SQLite migration wrapper left its sqlite3 connection open during temporary-directory cleanup after migration success; explicit connection close resolved the harness-only cleanup error and migration upgrade/preservation checks passed.
not_run: Live Ollama model inference and production job/document task consumer wiring: NOT_RUN; settings-only slice does not execute configured models.
Remote/paid AI providers: NOT_RUN under current local-only/budget policy.
GitHub Actions and hosted review: NOT_RUN under current local-only policy.
External job application submission: OFF; no submission path was changed.

limitations: The API/UI persists selections but no production task consumer currently loads them; broader requirement and issue remain PARTIAL/OPEN.
Only disabled and loopback-only Ollama are selectable because those are the registered provider implementations in this candidate.
No prompts, credentials, profile facts or application data are stored in the new settings table.
